comment: Leviathan 2.9.1 source (commit c37193d, branch puffy-rc3): TDScope.cpp declares no parameters, inputs or outputs at all, only two lights, so the entry is a first line, notes and menu items. It reads leftExpander.module and checks it is a Temporal Deck, which means it goes to the RIGHT of the deck. The waveform is a plain display widget with drag handling of its own; no click on it reaches this feature. The Debug Render submenu is only built when the maker's debug flag is set and is left out.
